$comment: D-1 phase 1 admission, 2026-11-21 (owner decision: merge panels/autoPanels/backOffice into screens/experiences). One slot now; $defs/autoPanel stays only as admin's body until phase 2 removes the root autoPanels key.

declarative.why: a block of settings for the generated back-office pages of the screen's concept (route, surfaces, selection columns, detail, transaction, prompt); nothing is computed

notLower.why: the pages are generated by the platform (list, detail, edit, picker per concept); no expression, function or step can produce a routed, permission-checked CRUD surface

twice.note: every built-in pack declares its concepts' back-office pages this way (sales, contacts, products, helpdesk, approvals, inventory, purchasing, leave, tracing); it replaces the root autoPanels[] key, one-for-one

enforced.note: AdminScreenEquivalenceTest compiles the same app written with autoPanels[] and with admin screens and asserts the compiled panels and autoPanels are identical; ExperienceValidationTest refuses admin on the wrong kind or repeating name/concept
